title: Guilherme de Pádua is sentenced to 19 years in prison for the 1992 murder of actress Daniella Perez.
text: Daniella Ferrante Perez Gazolla was a Brazilian actress and dancer. She worked in telenovelas such as Barriga de Aluguel (1990) and De Corpo e Alma (1992), both written by her mother.

title: A Jornal Nacional report on TV Globo, shows images of military police officers from São Paulo caught attacking residents of Favela Naval, in Diadema, during a blitz they carried out there. Mario José Josino died from a gunshot to the back…

title: The program Planeta Xuxa premiers on TV Globo.
text: Planeta Xuxa is a Brazilian television program directed by Marlene Mattos and hosted by Xuxa Meneghel. It was aired by TV Globo from 5 April 1997 to 28 July 2002.

title: Galdino Jesus dos Santos, a Pataxó native, is murdered by five students from Brasília after celebrating Indigenous Peoples Day.
text: In Brazil Indigenous Peoples Day, observed annually on April 19, recognizes and honours the Indigenous peoples of Brazil. The date was created by President Getúlio Vargas by a decree in 1943 and recalls the day (April 19) in 1940, in which several Indigenous leaderships of the Americas decided to attend the First Inter-American Indian Congress, held in Mexico.

title: The company Vale do Rio Doce is privatized and sold to Consórcio Brasil, led by CSN, for R$3.3 billion.
text: Vale, formerly Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (Doce River Valley Company), is a Brazilian multinational corporation engaged in metals and mining and one of the largest logistics operators in Brazil. Vale is the largest producer of iron ore and nickel in the world.

title: Brazil defeats Bolivia 3-1, to win their fifth Copa America trophy.
text: The 1997 Copa América final was the final match of the 38th edition of the Copa America tournament. The match was held on 29 June 1997, in Estadio Hernando Siles Stadium at La Paz, Bolivia.

title: Pope John Paul II visits Rio de Janeiro to participate in the 2nd World Meeting with Families.

title: Brazil defeats Australia 6-0 to win the 1997 FIFA Confederations Cup.
text: The 1997 FIFA Confederations Cup final was a football match to determine the winners of the 1997 FIFA Confederations Cup. The match was held at King Fahd II Stadium, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on 21 December 1997, and was contested by Brazil and Australia.
